read_flow_middlebury: read a Middlebury format .flo optical flow file and return a numpy array
write_flow_middlebury: write optical flow data to a Middlebury format .flo file
read_flow_kitti: read a KITTI format optical flow image and return flow and validity arrays
write_flow_kitti: write optical flow data to a KITTI format PNG image file
read_gen_generic: read image or flow files by extension including .png, .flo, .pfm, and .bin
